title: Continental SKU families launch: communications, partner enablement, and fallback playbook
creator: Priya Shah
summary: Prepare cross-functional go-to-market and release coordination for adding three new instance SKUs across EMEA and LATAM regions, including reservation bundles, pricing messaging, docs, sales enablement, runbooks, and fallback policies.
background: We are introducing three new Dedicated SKU families optimized for medium-latency workloads in EMEA and LATAM. This launch combines product, pricing, and regional capacity coordination with a bookings/reservations offering. Prior launches have shown gaps in runbook clarity and release notes parity between Console and API clients.
goals: Ship clear release notes and Console banners that map SKU names to existing families
Ensure Sales & Partner teams have pricing and cancellation FAQs before soft-launch
Provide Oncall & SRE with fallback routing playbook to mitigate saturation events
Verify telemetry and billing tags are live by rollout start
Collect early telemetry to validate unit economics within 2 weeks of launch
stakeholders: Sofia Chen (Design) - Console banners and docs UX
success_metrics: Reservation conversion rate >= 8% in first 60 days
Average 95th percentile tail latency within target SLOs for new SKUs
Billing tag accuracy > 99% for reservations and burst usage
No P0 incidents caused by SKU misrouting during first 14 days
constraints: Region capacity availability (cloud partner quotas) may delay launch for specific AZs
Console banner localization requires translations for 8 locales
Billing pipeline requires a hotfix to attach 'reservation_family' tag for early customers

open_risks: Billing tag hotfix may slip and cause inaccurate invoices for first customers
Autoscaling policies for new SKUs not tuned could lead to elevated costs or saturation
Localized release notes translations could be delayed by third-party vendor
Sales team enablement trailing the soft-launch window
rollout_steps: Step 1: Feature-flag SKUs in Console for internal testing only
Step 2: Enable SKUs for pilot tenants (whitelist) and monitor telemetry for 72 hours
Step 3: Execute reservation billing validation run with Finance on test invoices
Step 4: Push localized Console banners and API release notes simultaneously
Step 5: Soft-launch to key partners and enterprise pilot list
Step 6: Public announce and enable self-serve reservations
Step 7: Post-launch 48/72 hour incident war room if alerts triggered
release_notes_draft: Summary: Introducing three new Dedicated SKU families in EMEA and LATAM designed for production inference workloads with improved cost-to-performance for medium-latency use cases. Notes: - New SKUs: RD-M2 (balanced memory/compute), RD-C2 (compute-optimized), RD-B2 (burstable with lower base price). - Reservations: 1/3/12-month reservation bundles available at launch. - Known limitations: burst capacity availability will vary by AZ; see reservations page for quota details. - Migration: existing reserved customers can exchange credits within first 30 days; contact support for assistance.
